# Overnight Arc

> A record of what happened on the US market last session, and of where money is moving. Every weeknight after the US close a scan reads end-of-day prices for about 1,900 US-listed stocks and the funds that hold them, scores each against its own peer group, and writes the result here. Published by Insight Arc Solutions, Dubai.

Everything is end-of-day and delayed, never live. Momentum is cross-sectional: a 0-100 position against a peer group, so 50 is the median and a high score in a falling market means fell least. A score is a ranking, not a return, and nothing here is investment advice or personalised to anyone.

The value chains are hand-made and match no index and no fund’s holdings. Fund holdings are reproduced from issuer files and are sometimes partial; where a page says so, an absence is missing data and not evidence that a fund does not hold something.

## Start here

- [The four live boards](https://overnightarc.com/)

- [About, and what this is not good at](https://overnightarc.com/about/)

## Value chains, stage by stage

HBM), Advanced Packaging & Test, Networking & Interconnect, Optical & Photonics, Power Delivery & Electrical, Thermal & Cooling, Servers, Systems & ODMs, Data-Center Real Estate, Power Generation & Grid, Hyperscalers / Cloud (the Buyers), AI Software, Platforms & Apps](https://overnightarc.com/themes/ai/)

- [Crypto & Blockchain — 5 stages, 14 companies: Crypto Compute & Power, Bitcoin Miners, Exchanges & Brokers, Stablecoins & Payments, Corporate BTC Treasuries](https://overnightarc.com/themes/crypto/)
